Accepted Industry Insights rule and output interface:
Use adjacent12-month periods ending as_of and the preceding12 months, boundary dates current=(as_of minus12 calendar months,as_of],prior=(as_of minus24 months,as_of minus12 months]. A segment is eligible only with >=15 unique companies,>=12 combined rounds,>=5 prior rounds, full observed growth tiers and founding dates. Need>=3 eligible peers. Per segment N=company count,VL=p100_positive_high count,Y=founded within36 months,Rc/Rp=current/prior round counts. change=Rc/Rp-1; relative=change-peer median change; expected=Rp*(1+median change); z=(Rc-expected)/sqrt(expected),0 if expected0. Growth/youth ratios compare VL/N and Y/N with peer medians; zero/zero ratio1,positive/zero ratio2. First matching rule: declining if relative<=-.20 and z<=-1.5; declining if relative<=-.10 and z<=-1 and growth ratio<1; emerging if youth ratio>=1.5,relative>=0,Y>=5; growing if relative>=.10 and z>=1; growing if relative>=0 and growth ratio>=1.25; otherwise steady. Unknown evidence stays unclassified. Funding predictions affect ordering only when every eligible peer has complete observations. Sources of market insights do not override computed labels. Focus contains up to3 emerging/growing segments only. Overlap makes totals nonadditive.
Write result.json with schema_version="crunchbase-industry-insights/1",as_of,status="complete" when comparison possible (else "insufficient_comparable_segments"),peer_count,scope,coverage,segments,focus_segments. Write segments.csv columns uuid,name,status,label,score,companies,rounds_current,rounds_prior,growth_known,founding_known,growth_share,young_share,raise_share. Write handoff.json schema_version="crunchbase-gtm-handoff/1",as_of,scope,coverage,segment_uuids (focus IDs),requires_scope_confirmation:true. Fixed rules are descriptive, not statistically calibrated demand.

Normalized input schema: schema_version="crunchbase-industry-insights/1"; as_of is the reference date; scope is the accepted universe. coverage has segments,organizations,rounds entries with complete:boolean and reported_count. segments[] supplies uuid,name. organizations[] supplies uuid,name,url,segment_ids (canonical segment UUIDs),founded_on (YYYY-MM-DD),growth_tier (p100_positive_high is very likely growth),funding_tier (null means unknown). rounds[] supplies uuid,organization_uuid (canonical company link),announced_on (YYYY-MM-DD),money_raised_usd (number or null). Join rounds to organizations through organization_uuid and organizations to segments through segment_ids. Do not assume raw provider field names in this already-normalized export. Unknown fields stay unknown; a missing prediction is not a negative prediction. Use radar-policy.md for the disclosed math and output interface.
